name: Queen
ability: You start knowing three characters, exactly one of which is in-play.
flavor: Bow, peasants.

name: Peasant
ability: On your 1st night, pick a number. On the corresponding night, learn that many things (One is wrong).
flavor: Work work.

name: Executioner
ability: You start knowing a good player. Once per game, at night*: You may choose for that living player to die & for the Demon not to kill tonight.
flavor: You really only need to hang mean bastards. But mean bastards, you need to hang.

name: Shapeshifter
ability: On night 1: you gain a different Townsfolk ability. Once per game at night: replace that ability with a new ability. If you do, you might register as evil, Minion or Demon, even if dead
flavor: What shall we be today?

reminders: has no ability, has another ability
name: Mechanic
ability: Once per game at night*: choose an alive player (not yourself) and a good character. If not-in-play, that player gains that characters ability tonight.
flavor: The clay does not say to the potter, 'What do you think you are you making?'

otherNightReminder: Chooses a player, might cause death
name: Hitman
ability: Each night*: choose a player. If they die today or tonight: tomorrow night, a player of their alignment dies
flavor: Stab-Stab.

otherNightReminder: Choose a Player, Learns if chosen by evil
name: Crusader
ability: Each night*: choose a player. Tonight, you learn if any evil character's abilities target that player and they target you instead, even if dead.
flavor: Thee shall not kill. If thee wants to kill thee shall have to go through me.

name: Actress
ability: Each night: choose a character (Not Yourself): if in-play, learn if their neighbors are the same alignment. Else, this information is arbitrary.
flavor: All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players. They have their exits and their entrances; And one man in his time plays many parts.

name: Inquisitor
ability: Each day: You may publicly ask one player a yes or no question. If they knowingly lie about their answer, you learn this tonight.
flavor: Nobody expects... ME!

otherNightReminder: Learns character that has been nominated
name: Attorney
ability: Each night*: If someone died today: learn a character that has been nominated today.
flavor: To be fair, "I am the Imp" is a statement that has cultural significance for my client and could be interpreted in any number of ways, this does in no way mean that my client is in fact the imp. Paradoxically, it makes it highly unlikely that my esteemed client is the Imp and I would warn you of making such assumptions.

name: Mortician
ability: Each night*: choose a player. The first time you die at night, that player, if good and alive, dies instead.
flavor: Death might be the end for you, for me it is just a way of making a living.

name: Veteran
ability: Once per game, if you publicly claim to be the Veteran: The 1st player that nominates you, if good, is executed immediatly.
flavor: Come at me, I dare you.

name: Starchild
ability: Once per game at night, after you died: You learn the Demon. When used, every evil player may guess the Starchild. If any guess correctly, learn false information.
flavor: A shining beacon, in the darkest night. Wish upon this star and see your dreams come true.

name: Harbinger
ability: When you die, the Demon chooses a character to become drunk.
flavor: It comes for us all, beware I tell you and keep your loved ones close. Or you might be the next corpse in our midst.

name: Cultist
ability: If you nominate a Demon or Minion while there are 5 or more players alive, and they die by that execution, you become that evil Character.
flavor: Join me in the dark. Keep it close to your heart and let the secret between us speak for itself.

otherNightReminder: Opposing alignment learns Bewitched has triggered
name: Bewitched
ability: If the Demon gets executed (ending the game): Play for one more day, even if dead (You learn this). Your team wins if, and only if, you get executed the following day.
flavor: A Curse to bear, a curse upon my name.

name: Scared Child
ability: You start knowing two players. If at least one of them is alive when the game ends, you become their alignment, even if dead. If both are dead, you die at night.
flavor: Mom? Are you out there?

name: Charybdis
ability: 2 players do not learn their character (They still function normally). You start knowing their characters. [+2 blank tokens, blank evil players do not learn their team]
flavor: All will be lost, Name, Memories, even Family, in the grand Vortex.

name: Beholding
ability: Each night choose a player (Not yourself). They are poisoned until dawn and things that player is publicly mad about tomorrow might come true.
flavor: Be careful what you wish for. Be careful what you think. Be ESPECIALLY careful about what you say. You never know who might listen.

name: Judge
ability: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a living player. That day: If either you or they are executed, their team loses.
flavor: His feet are light and nimble. He never sleeps. He says that he will never die. He dances in light and in shadow and he is a great favorite. He never sleeps, the judge. He is dancing, dancing. He says that he will never die.

name: Asag
ability: Each outsider, and you, have this additional ability: "You may die at any night. If 5 or less players are alive, you immediately die". [+1 Outsiders OR One Townsfolk registers as Outsider]
flavor: The World shall be reforged. Not in peace, not with politicians or the hopes of men. The World will wake anew, forged in fire and steel.

name: Es Mentiras
ability: Each night*: choose a player, they die. A good player knows you are in play. If that player gets executed, their team loses.
flavor: Nothing is more dangerous than an honest liar.

name: Antigonish
ability: Each night*: choose a player: they die OR choose two players, they swap characters. (You choose which happens)
flavor:
Last night I saw upon the stair,
A little man who wasn't there
He wasn't there again today
Oh, how I wish he'd go away....

name: Hunt
ability: Each night*: choose a player: they die. The first two Outsiders you choose at night turn evil and learn the demon. [+2 Outsiders, -1 Minions]
flavor: Find, Search, Hunt, Kill with claw and teeth. Enjoy the festivities. Enjoy your meal. The chase is better than the catch.

name: She who weaves
ability: Each day: good players who publicly chose to die, die that night. Each Night*: If no player dies due to this, choose three players. They die.
flavor: Why should we go out, tire ourself out in the search for the next morsel. They will do fine on their own, walking step by step, deeper into the web.
